purpose: Read-only, version-bound governance worksheet. Candidate matches are recommendations only; no taxonomy record, lesson, study link, review state, canonical question, or learner record is modified.

matching_policy.topic_registry_identity: Exact taxonomy ID and normalized exact name are checked against the current registry. Existing B715 candidate suggestions are rechecked for current record presence and exactness.
matching_policy.near_match_policy: No new fuzzy candidates are generated in B716. Similarity values are preserved only from the existing B715 deterministic candidate list and remain nonbinding.
matching_policy.study_section_policy: Exact section match is recomputed from current published study material and its published lesson sections; related material is never upgraded to exact support.

shared_proposed_topic_group.meaning: Same proposed topic ID is reused across proposals; preserve one label and review its applicability per item. This is not an instruction to merge or activate taxonomy.

taxonomy.required_action: A scoped TAXONOMY_RECONCILE reviewer must explicitly map to a current valid topic or submit a separate owner-governed taxonomy request. Concepts remain unresolved until a governed decision. No label is activated by this worksheet.

governance_actions.taxonomy: Resolve candidate ambiguity or submit a governed taxonomy request; do not auto-map by text similarity.
governance_actions.study: Owner/content-governance decision is required to author a real lesson section; otherwise retain relationship unresolved/optional.
governance_actions.academic: Source review and version-bound academic review remain separate and pending.

required_owner_and_reviewer_path.taxonomy: Owner confirms taxonomy governance route and delegates only to a reviewer with active exact-board/exact-subject TAXONOMY_RECONCILE scope; reviewer records an explicit item-level mapping or an owner-governed proposal. Unregistered labels stay inactive.
required_owner_and_reviewer_path.study: A reviewer with active exact-board/exact-subject STUDY_LINK scope verifies the currently published material and exact section. Missing lessons/sections require actual content governance; no placeholder section or link is created.
required_owner_and_reviewer_path.audit: Keep proposal version, current taxonomy/study snapshot, reviewer identity/grant and explicit decision together. Any relevant snapshot change invalidates downstream approval/import readiness.
